props.title: Live music at Denver hotels and conference centers.
props.lede: You’ve booked the hotel, and now you’re picturing the music in it. Every hotel has its own spaces, its own way in for the band and its own sound limits, and we plan the music around all of it.

headingText.html: Here’s what live music looks like at the hotels and conference centers where our artists play, with the acts we’d pick for each space.

props.title: How live music works at your hotel

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, and we’ll always size it to the space and to the hotel’s specs.
In most cases, we carry the insurance for the event, too.
We coordinate unloading and setup with the hotel’s staff.
We plan the music around the hotel’s sound limits, and we can turn it up or down whenever you need.

props.title: Planning an event at another hotel?
props.lede: We book acts at hotels and conference centers all over Denver, the Front Range and the mountain towns. Just send us your date and the hotel, and we’ll take it from there.
props.note: Want some more ideas? Take a look at live music for corporate events, weddings and private parties.
